svg.text: THE 22 MONSTER TYPES (GMONSTERTYPES, DS:1A3B, 27 BYTES EACH)
level: the dungeon levels whose LEVELn.INF has the type among its 30 starting records (decoded from the files); none: in no starting record, so placed
by a script or unused [?]. AC and THAC0 are descending (lower AC is harder to hit). HD: hit points are RollDice(HD, 8) (1d4 for -1); XP is what the whole
party shares. Flags: H1 Hold Person works, H2 Hold Monster works, U undead (turnable), E halves damage from edged weapons, move: may swing after
moving, P poison, Z paralysis, R ranged or spell attack, T destroys a metal item. Resists is the Magic Resistance percentage, a roll of 1d100 below it
